title: A Uniform for the Typewriter
author: Ivo Vane
blurb: Theo Blackwood, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the census taker asks one question too many, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
